title: Embarrassed Emoji & Kaomoji: Copy & Paste 😳😬 Awkward Combos
meta_description: Embarrassed emoji 😳 😬 🙃 for mortified 'oh no' reactions, cringe moments, and slip-ups, plus awkward kaomoji like (ノ_<。). Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: The 😳 flushed face, cringe grimaces, mortified caught-in-the-act faces, and awkward kaomoji for every social slip-up. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The embarrassed emoji 😳 is what you send right after you realize everyone saw that — not the warm flutter of a compliment, but the hot-faced, 'let the floor open up' reaction to a slip-up, a wrong-name mix-up, or a joke that landed wrong. This page collects the full mortified range: the classic flushed 😳 and nervous-sweat 😅 duo, cringe reactions like 😬 and 🫠 for watching a social disaster unfold in real time, and the caught-out faces — 🤭, 😯, 🤐 — for the beat right after you say something you can't take back. Awkward kaomoji like (ノ_<。) and m(_ _)m carry the same mortified energy in plain text, for chats and comments where emoji don't quite land the same way. If you're after the softer, rosy-cheeked side of blushing instead — shy compliments, flattered reactions, a warm 'you're making me shy' moment — the blush emoji page linked below is the one to grab. Copy a single face here, or grab a ready-made combo set for the aftermath of any cringe moment.
